title: Stop Before You Fail: Operational Capability Boundaries for Mitigating Unproductive Reasoning in Large Reasoning Models
abstract: arXiv:2509.24711v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Current answering paradigms for Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) often fail to account for the fact that some questions may lie beyond the model's operational capability boundary, leading to long but unproductive reasoning. In this paper, we study whether LRMs expose early signals predictive of such cases, and whether these signals can be used to mitigate unproductive reasoning. In black-box settings, we find that reasoning expressions contain failure-predictive signals. In white-box settings, we show that the hidden states of the last input token contain information that is predictive of whether a question will not be solved correctly under our evaluation setup. Building on these observations, we propose two test-time monitoring strategies: reasoning expression monitoring and hidden states monitoring, that reduce token usage by 62.7-93.6%, substantially improving efficiency and reliability while largely preserving accuracy.

translated_title: 在失败前停止：用于缓解大型推理模型无效推理的操作能力边界
translated_abstract: 当前大型推理模型（LRMs）的回答范式往往未能考虑到某些问题可能超出模型的操作能力边界这一事实，从而导致冗长但无效的推理。本文研究了大型推理模型是否会暴露出能够预测此类情况的早期信号，以及这些信号能否用于缓解无效推理。在黑盒设置中，我们发现推理表达中包含可预测失败的信号。在白盒设置中，我们表明最后一个输入词元的隐藏状态包含能够预测问题在评估设置下是否无法被正确解决的信息。基于这些观察，我们提出了两种测试时监控策略：推理表达监控和隐藏状态监控，可将词元使用量减少62.7%-93.6%，在基本保持准确率的同时显著提升了效率和可靠性。
tldr: 该论文发现大型推理模型的推理表达和隐藏状态中均存在可预测推理失败的早期信号，并据此提出两种测试时监控策略，可将词元使用量减少62.7%-93.6%，在基本保持准确率的同时大幅提升推理效率与可靠性。
